title: Console demo declared input corpus
purpose: The declared input material for the console demo protocol. It is the run's grounding object: the phase declares `inputs: [input-corpus:console_demo_v1]`, the composition root stores exactly these bytes under that artifact id, and the run chain registers the object as a source whose digest is recomputable from this file (GOAL-010 EC-02).
scope: This corpus describes the controlled demo exercise itself, not a research subject.
The demo protocol is a controlled Fake agent loop; the browser UI discloses that fact and does not claim real research execution.
What this object proves: the deliverable has a checkable grounding relation to a declared input. What it does not prove: that the session actually read it -- only a tool observation could show that.

documents.title: Demo protocol shape
documents.text: Two linear phases, discovery then review. Both phases carry the console_demo_deliverable contract, require the artifact.read capability, and declare this corpus as their input.

documents.title: Acceptance criteria in force
documents.text: ARTIFACT_EXISTS names analysis_report literally, and EVIDENCE_COVERAGE requires at least one source that is not the task's own output.

documents.title: Evidence rule
documents.text: A source counts toward coverage only when its object was not produced by the agent under evaluation. Model self-report is therefore excluded by construction, not by convention.
